turnout_basis: votes cast (incl. informal and disallowed) as % of enrolled electors

government.pm: John Key (to 12 Dec 2016), then Bill English
government.name: Fifth National Government (third term)
government.notes: National won 61 of 121 seats on election night but lost one seat (to the Greens) on the official count, leaving 60. It re-signed confidence-and-supply agreements with ACT, United Future (29 Sep 2014) and the Māori Party (5 Oct 2014). Ministry sworn in 8 Oct 2014. John Key resigned in Dec 2016; Bill English became PM on 12 Dec 2016.

notes: Electorate majorities/runners-up are taken from the official-count vote tables in each electorate's Wikipedia article (which cite the Electoral Commission's official results pages); where the summary table, the article's majority box and the candidate vote counts disagree, the value two of them agree on is used – see 'majority_corrections'.

Cross-check: national party-vote totals vs the sum of per-electorate official party votes in the electorate articles – largest gap +2838 votes (labour, 0.12% of valid votes); gaps are attributed to transcription errors in individual electorate articles, and the national (Electoral Commission summary) figures are used.
